blocks.story: HITL Queue Dashboard - Trust signals show verification status

story-overview.user-story: As an End-user, I want to see whether an answer is verified or AI-generated, so that I know how much to trust it.
story-overview.business-value: Trust signals are critical for user confidence in AI-generated answers. Clear visual badges help users calibrate their trust: verified KB answers (human-approved) vs. RAG-generated answers (AI-created from context). Pending verification state manages expectations when low-confidence answers require human review before sending.
story-overview.technical-summary: Implement three trust level badges: "✓ Verified" (green, from Verified KB), "AI Generated" (amber, from RAG pipeline), and "Pending" (blue, awaiting HITL review). Integrate confidence scoring from Story 3.4 to determine routing (high confidence → auto-send with badge, low confidence → HITL queue with pending state). Use status polling to notify users when HITL agent approves pending responses. Ensure WCAG AA accessibility with proper ARIA labels and color contrast ratios.

key-functional-requirements.requirement: Chat displays "Verified" badge for Verified KB answers
Low-confidence responses display "I'm checking with the team"
System calculates and returns confidence score (0-100%)
Chat displays AI responses with source citations

ac.given: An answer came from the Verified Knowledge Base
ac.when: I see the response in the chat
ac.then: - I see a green "✓ Verified" badge near the top of the response - Badge has light green background: #DCFCE7 (bg-green-100) - Text is dark green: #166534 (text-green-900)

ac.given: I hover over the "✓ Verified" badge
ac.then: - Tooltip displays: "This answer has been verified by a human expert" - Optionally shows: "Updated: [date]"

ac.given: An answer was generated by the RAG pipeline (not from Verified KB)
ac.when: I see the response in the chat
ac.then: - I see an amber "AI Generated" badge - Badge has light amber background: #FEF3C7 (bg-amber-100) - Text is dark amber: #92400E (text-amber-900)

ac.given: I hover over the "AI Generated" badge
ac.then: - Tooltip displays: "This answer was generated by AI from our knowledge base" - Shows confidence level: "Confidence: 85%"

ac.given: An answer has low confidence (< configured threshold, typically 80%)
ac.then: - Response is NOT sent to user immediately - User sees: "I'm checking with the team. You'll receive a verified response shortly."

ac.when: The agent reviews and approves it
ac.then: - Notification appears: "✓ We have an answer for you!" - Verified response appears in chat - Response displays "✓ Verified" badge
- Confidence score (0-100%) is calculated but NOT shown in chat UI - Confidence is used internally for routing (high → user, low → HITL queue)
- Shows "✓ Verified" or "AI Generated" badge (no percentage) - User sees it as trusted information

ac.given: A chat message has multiple components
ac.then: Order (top to bottom): 1. Message content (large, readable) 2. Citations (inline and/or footnotes) 3. Badge (✓ Verified or AI Generated) 4. Feedback icons (thumbs up/down)
- Badges are consistent in style and placement - Different badge types are clearly distinguishable
Screen reader announces: - "Verified, this answer has been verified by a human expert" - OR "AI Generated, this answer was generated by AI"
- Colors meet WCAG AA contrast standards (4.5:1 ratio)
- Badge is NOT shown until generation is complete - "Generating..." placeholder appears
- NO badge is shown - Error message takes precedence

ac.given: Confidence score is exactly at threshold (e.g., 80%)
ac.then: - Treated as high-confidence → shown to user with badge - Routing: >= threshold → user, < threshold → HITL

task.title: Implement Status Polling
task.description: Poll status endpoint every 2 seconds to check if pending response is verified. When status changes, update UI with verified response and show notification.

task.title: Optimistic UI for Pending State
task.description: Show pending state immediately when message sent with low confidence. Don't wait for server response to display "checking with team" message.
task.acceptance: - On message send, if confidence < threshold (from server), immediately show pending - Pending message appears instantly (optimistic rendering) - User knows to wait for verification - No awkward delay before pending state shown

task.title: Integrate Confidence Scoring Service
task.description: Call ConfidenceScoringService from Story 3.4 in chat response pipeline. Use confidence score to determine routing: high → auto-send with badge, low → HITL queue.
task.acceptance: - ChatService.generate_response() calls ConfidenceScoringService.calculate_score() - Confidence score calculated using 40% retrieval + 30% source consistency + 30% generation - Score returned with response metadata - Routing decision: score >= threshold → user, score < threshold → HITL queue - Response includes: trustLevel, confidenceScore, sourceType

task.title: Implement Trust Level Logic
task.description: Determine trustLevel based on answer source: verified_kb → "verified", rag → "ai_generated", low confidence → "pending". Return metadata with response.
task.acceptance: - If answer from Verified KB: trustLevel = "verified", confidenceScore = 95 - If answer from RAG and confidence >= threshold: trustLevel = "ai_generated" - If answer from RAG and confidence < threshold: trustLevel = "pending" - Response JSON includes: response, trustLevel, confidenceScore, sourceType, responseId

task.title: Create Verified KB Check Service
task.description: Implement service to check if answer exists in Verified KB. Query verified_kb table for approved answers matching the query.
task.acceptance: - VerifiedKBService.find_match(bot_id, query) method created - Query verified_kb table for approved answers - Use semantic search to find best match (cosine similarity > 0.9) - Return answer if match found, else None - Cache results (5 min TTL) to reduce DB load
task.database-query: SELECT vk.id, vk.question, vk.answer, vk.citations, vk.updated_at FROM verified_kb vk WHERE vk.bot_id = :bot_id AND vk.status = 'approved' AND vk.question_embedding <=> :query_embedding < 0.1 -- cosine distance < 0.1 = similarity > 0.9 ORDER BY vk.question_embedding <=> :query_embedding LIMIT 1;

task.title: Create Status Check Endpoint

task.acceptance: - GET /api/v1/chat/:message_id/status endpoint created - Returns: { status: "pending" | "resolved", response?: {...} } - If resolved, includes full response with trustLevel "verified" - Cache status checks (1 sec TTL) to prevent DB hammering - Invalidate cache when HITL agent approves response

components.component: Maximum cosine similarity of top retrieved chunks. High similarity = relevant context.

dev-notes.note: Trust signals provide transparency about answer source and verification status. Three trust levels: verified (human-approved from Verified KB), ai_generated (RAG pipeline with high confidence), and pending (awaiting HITL review due to low confidence). Confidence score determines routing but is NOT shown to end-users (internal only).
Status polling uses 2-second interval with 1-second Redis cache to prevent DB hammering. Cache invalidated immediately when HITL agent approves response for quick UI updates.
All badge colors meet WCAG AA contrast standards (4.5:1). ARIA labels provide context for screen readers. Pending state uses role="status" for live region announcements.

Confidence score is sensitive internal data (not leaked to UI). Only trustLevel (verified/ ai_generated/pending) shown to users. Status endpoint checks authorization (only message owner can poll status).

Badge placement: after message content and citations, before feedback icons. Consistent positioning across all messages. Clear visual distinction between verified (green) and ai_generated (amber) to help users calibrate trust.
